posts.zh:
dsh-session-move 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 Web 侧边栏把会话移动到别的文件夹（拖拽或菜单选择），带风险确认地永久删除会话，以及 AI 重命名会话（总结整个对话并自动纠正错别字）；每个操作都提供 agent 工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fc0cc76d645375e86400.html
posts.en:
dsh-session-move is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversation (typo-aware). Each action also ships as an agent tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fc0cc76d645375e86400.html
